# anthropic_vaults (Data Source)

Lists Managed Agents vaults.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_vaults" "all" {
  include_archived = false
}

output "vault_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_vaults.all.vaults[*].display_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived vaults. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `vaults` (Attributes List) Vaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) Vault id.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
